t2.thesis: GLXY enters earnings after a steep drawdown with a hefty implied move and mixed signals, so the setup is close to a coin flip with a slight edge from the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for BMO buy-everything is about 54.8%, and crypto_proxy has too few events to rely on.
Stock is down about 60% over 12 months and 42% over 1 month, which leaves it oversold, and Citi upgraded it with a $28 target while estimates were revised up (I23, I18, I21).
Last 4 prints had a 25% win rate on the entry-to-exit open, with negative reactions even on large EPS beats, which suggests sell-the-news behaviour (I2).

Implied move is about 13.7% with a put-heavy open interest skew (put/call OI 1.4), and the stock is highly volatile, so the outcome is essentially driven by crypto beta and the Helios/CoreWeave narrative.
Run-up of about 8% on Oct 21 on the stablecoin rules before the print could raise the bar into earnings (I10, I11).
t2.deciding_variable: Data Centers lease revenue ramp (about $80M per quarter guided from Q3) and Helios new-tenant progress versus Treasury digital-asset marks, plus bitcoin's move over the weekend and Monday.

prior.from: I3 overall validation t0_hit 0.542 and BMO 0.548; crypto_proxy cluster (n=8, 0.25) is insufficient so ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-23, so the 2026-10-27 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how GLXY's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered from 0.54 to 0.52: weak recent print history and the crypto-beta bounce already priced in offset the oversold and upgrade tailwinds.

theses.expected: Rise: Q3 shows the first full quarter of CoreWeave Phase I revenue and improving adjusted EBITDA, with possible new tenant news for the uncontracted 830 MW.
theses.mechanism: Oversold stock with a high short interest (19%) squeezes on a positive data-center catalyst.
theses.wrong_if: No new tenant is announced and Treasury losses again dominate the net loss.

theses.expected: Fall: Sell-the-news after the bounce, with debt-cost worries on CoreWeave and the 9.875% notes weighing on the stock.
theses.mechanism: Four prior prints reacted negatively in 3 of 4 cases even with EPS beats, so the bar stays high.
theses.wrong_if: Results beat and guidance on Helios Phase II and tenant talks is upbeat.

theses.expected: Direction follows crypto beta: the entry-to-exit move tracks BTC and the sector over Oct 26-27.
theses.mechanism: Treasury and Corporate marks and trading activity are tied to digital asset prices.
theses.wrong_if: GLXY moves opposite to BTC on company-specific news.

key_observations: Data Centers revenue versus the ~$80M quarterly run-rate and project EBITDA margin above 90%
Any new Helios tenant or financing announcement
Treasury and Corporate gains/losses and the Q3 EPS versus the ~$0.11 consensus
Digital Assets adjusted gross profit and trading volumes
